summary: Split the previous working tree into two commits: a repo-wide prettier pass as its own commit, and the workspace-profiles refactor as a separate feature commit. After landing, restarted the long-running pi-web dev server so the agent-server on port 8787 picks up protocol 24.
decisions: Commit prettier formatting churn separately from the refactor, rather than trying to surgically untangle the formatting hunks from feature hunks.
Exclude .gizmo/profiles.json and .herenow/state.json from both commits, treating them as dev-server runtime churn left dirty in the working tree.

Restart the background pi-web dev server (via pnpm dev:server:restart) after the refactor commit so the running agent-server reloads with the new protocol; tell the user to reload the browser tab to match.
errors: After committing the refactor the user saw 'invalid agent protocol response' because the agent-server process had been running since before the refactor and was still on protocol 23; fixed by restarting the dev server (agent-server now listening on 8787) and asking the user to reload the browser.
